answer: In this proposal, an ID earns a daily listing by unicasting 1 GB of assigned encrypted imagery of violet beds, orchard trees or ocean life. Independent receivers meter bytes, check hashes and sign ID/day/job/byte receipts. The registry checks signatures, quota and job nonreuse; a failed check denies listing. Bandwidth use recurs; routers are reusable capital; no stake. Receiver collusion can fake delivery; spare capacity lowers marginal cost. With honest receivers, ten IDs require 10 GB/day even on shared routers or parallel links: delivery cannot be credited twice.
